lessons.title: Daily Routines, Music & Preferences
lessons.description: Expressing likes/dislikes, prefer, and music genres

questions.rule:
- Prefer: "I prefer pop music to rock music." (Tercih edilen TO tercih edilmeyen)
- Fond of / Keen on / Interested in: Hoşlanmak, ilgili olmak (+ Ving)
- Can't stand: Dayanamamak, katlanamamak
- Unbearable: Katlanılmaz, çekilmez
- Ridiculous: Gülünç, saçma
- Impressive: Etkileyici
questions.examTip: Prefer yapısında "to" kullanılır ("than" kullanılmaz): I prefer reading to watching TV.

questions.prompt:
Emma: "What do you think of heavy metal music?"
Liam: "To be honest, I can't stand it. It is too loud and _____."
questions.explanation: "I can't stand it" (katlanamıyorum) dediği için olumsuz bir sıfat olan "unbearable" (çekilmez) uygundur.

questions.prompt: David prefers _____ books to _____ computer games in his free time.
questions.explanation: Prefer + V-ing TO V-ing kuralı uygulanır: reading to playing.

questions.prompt: "Keen on" and "fond of" mean that you enjoy doing something.
questions.explanation: Both phrases express positive feelings (düşkün olmak, sevmek).

questions.prompt: My brother is crazy _____ skateboarding; he spends all day at the park.
questions.explanation: "Crazy about" bir şeye bayılmak, delisi olmak anlamına gelen kalıptır.

questions.prompt: Which music genre is described: "It is a traditional American style of music with instruments like banjo and acoustic guitar"?
questions.explanation: Acoustic guitar and banjo are typical instruments of country music.

questions.prompt: Match the adjectives with their opposites:
"How often do you go camping?" Which answer is suitable?
questions.explanation: "How often" ne sıklıkla sorusudur ve sıklık zarfı (Twice a month) gerektirir.

lessons.title: Teen Life Trophy Exam 🏆
lessons.description: LGS Teen Life Reading Comprehension & Routine Test

questions.rule:
In Teen Life survey questions:
- Most of the teenagers (Gençlerin çoğu: > %50)
- Nearly half of (Neredeyse yarısı: ~ %50)
- Few / Seldom (Çok az / nadiren)
- Nobody / None (Hiçbiri: %0)
questions.examTip: Pay close attention to percentages (%60, %15) in chart questions!

questions.prompt: According to a survey, 65% of teens prefer chatting online, 20% prefer playing sports, and 15% prefer reading books. Which sentence is CORRECT?
options: More than half of the teens prefer communicating on the Internet
Teens prefer playing sports the most
Reading books is the most popular activity
questions.explanation: %65 is more than half (> %50), so chatting online is the majority.

questions.prompt: Jack never eats junk food and always exercises. What can we say about Jack?
options: He is addicted to fast food
questions.explanation: Exercising and avoiding junk food indicates a healthy lifestyle.

questions.prompt: Trekking is a type of outdoor sport that involves _____ in nature.
"What time do you usually get up on weekdays?" - "_____."
questions.explanation: "What time" saat kaçta sorusudur; "At 7:00 AM" zamanı belirtir.

questions.prompt: Match teen activity verbs with nouns:
Which word means "fashionable and popular at the moment"?
